Wallet._comment: ManualTopUpEnabled is off: card-to-card means a person reading a bank statement and deciding whether an image is genuine, and turning it on commits the store to staffing that queue. The flow is built and tested either way. Amounts are Toman.

DevOtp._comment: One number whose sign-in code is fixed, so a developer with no SMS gateway can log in. Development only — Program.cs registers the decorator that reads this only when the host is in Development, and this file is the only one that carries it. Blank the phone to turn it off; every other number still gets a real random code, and this one still gets a real challenge with a real expiry and attempt counter.

TrustedProxy._comment: Shared secret the two Next.js servers send as X-Api-Key. Both apps send the same value; production must use a different one, and it must never reach a browser.

Seed._comment: Fills an empty database with the design's own catalogue. Every table that already has rows is skipped, so leaving this on is idempotent. AdminPassword has no default: without one there is simply no operator account to sign in with.

Email._comment: Where the links in a transactional email point. The API has no other way to know the storefront's address, and mail is composed on a worker where there is no request to derive it from.
